messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009 [decision; valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- INC-2026-009: the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03; the root cause was two leaders elected during a network partition [valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- Ember noticed that the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump [observation; valid 2026-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-19-2]
- Atlas noticed that the scheduler's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade [observation; valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-09-2]
- The handover note of 2025-08-29 wrongly recorded Cinder as the owner of the scheduler [valid 2025-09-05 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction]
- Decision: the scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node, because the fixed node turned every restart into a missed run [decision; valid 2025-06-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-06-13]
- Dune owns the scheduler [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-15-scheduler]
    earlier: Atlas owns the scheduler [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-10-15; recorded by handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction]
    earlier: Cinder owns the scheduler [valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-09-05; recorded by handover/2025-08-29-scheduler]
    earlier: Ember owns the scheduler [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- Decision: notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds, because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes during INC-2025-004 [decision; valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- The scheduler deploys only on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC [constraint; valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-27-2]
    earlier: The scheduler deploys only on weekdays after 15:00 UTC [constraint; valid 2025-03-19 to 2025-10-27; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-19]
- Decision: clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds, because feature-flags saw 40,000 requests per second at peak and most of them were identical [decision; valid 2025-07-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-28]
- Cinder noticed that the ledger's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change [observation; valid 2026-01-05 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-05]
- The scheduler depends on feature-flags [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-28]
- Dune noticed that reporting's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy [observation; valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10-2]
- Decision: the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff, because the flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages [decision; valid 2025-02-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-20]
- Decision: reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023 [decision; valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- Decision: billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch [decision; valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2]
- No deploys to billing-api from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 because of the peak season [constraint; valid 2025-11-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-04]
- The handover note of 2025-06-20 wrongly recorded Ember as the owner of webhooks [valid 2025-07-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-04-webhooks-correction]
- Cinder noticed that the ledger's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy [observation; valid 2025-07-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-28-2]
- Boreal noticed that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout [observation; valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2]
